label: Local source cache path policy
path_review_rules: Future private roots require a reviewed runtime task before creation.
Generated audit evidence may use control/audits/**/generated/source_cache/ only when an explicit output path is provided.
Contracts, runtime modules, generated site assets, publication inventory, and master-index-related roots are forbidden output roots.
Private user-file paths, credential paths, account-session paths, and secret paths are forbidden.
notes: This policy records future roots but does not create them.
B-13 creates no local source-cache state.
